description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Widana Arachchilage Padmasiri Hemachandra as Chairman of the Medirigiriya Pradeshiya Sabha and Mr. Balakrishnan Sridar as a member of the Udapalatha Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Medirigiriya Pradeshiya Sabha and Udapalatha Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes for local authorities, including the declaration of elected officials (Chairman and member) to fill positions that became vacant due to removal and party membership changes. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and appointments within local government electoral systems.
